message.content: Now start the service as a detached background process (redirected stdio, PID recorded).

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "cd \"$(pwd)\"; rm -f service.nohup service.pid; nohup python3 service.py > service.nohup 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo $! > service.pid; disown; sleep 1; echo \"pid=$(cat service.pid)\"; ps -o pid,ppid,stat,cmd -p \"$(cat service.pid)\"; echo \"--- log ---\"; cat service.nohup"}
